title: One run, one phrase
label: A homepage hero for multi-agent orchestration. Under a large headline, three quiet musical staves run across the stage, named Planner, Coder and Reviewer. One agent run plays across them as a single phrase: a line travels note to note, and each note lands on the stave of the agent doing that step, with a short label such as split the task, implement retries or review diff. After seven steps the line comes to rest on a chord, three dark noteheads stacked on one stem across all three staves, and a tag beside it reads Approved, run #1842, 7 steps, 38s.
heading:
Plan, build, review.
One run, in time.
sub: Your agents hand work to each other like a phrase of music, and every run resolves into one approved result.
